
# ---- Appendix: Study 2 Analyses (ANOVA / ANCOVA, sjPlot outputs) ----

```{r setup-appendix, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(dplyr, tidyr, stringr, janitor, ggplot2,
               car, effectsize, sjPlot, emmeans, broom, purrr, tibble)
theme_set(sjPlot::theme_sjplot())
options(contrasts = c("contr.treatment", "contr.poly"))
```

## Data prep (robust to missing flags / columns)

```{r data-prep-appendix}
# prefer attention-filtered data if present
dat0 <- if (exists("dat_attn")) dat_attn else if (exists("dat")) dat else stop("No data object named dat_attn or dat found.")

# Coerce score to numeric if needed (Qualtrics scores often come in as character)
score_col <- c("Score","score","SC0","Q_Score","TotalScore")
score_col <- score_col[score_col %in% names(dat0)][1] %||% "Score"
if (!score_col %in% names(dat0)) stop("Could not find a score column. Expected one of: ", paste(score_col, collapse=", "))

dat0 <- dat0 %>% mutate(score = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[score_col]])))

# If hierarchy / chartjunk not present, derive from version
if (!all(c("hierarchy","chartjunk") %in% names(dat0))) {
  version_col <- c("version","Version","condition","Condition")
  version_col <- version_col[version_col %in% names(dat0)][1] %||% "version"
  if (!version_col %in% names(dat0)) stop("Need either (hierarchy, chartjunk) or a version column to derive from.")

  dat0 <- dat0 %>% mutate(
    hierarchy = case_when(
      str_detect(.data[[version_col]], regex("NoHierarchy", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "NoHierarchy",
      str_detect(.data[[version_col]], regex("RoomHierarchy", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "RoomHierarchy",
      str_detect(.data[[version_col]], regex("ImportanceHierarchy", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "ImportanceHierarchy",
      str_detect(.data[[version_col]], regex("FloorplanHierarchy", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "FloorplanHierarchy",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    chartjunk = case_when(
      str_detect(.data[[version_col]], regex("HighChartjunk|ChartjunkHigh|High", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "High",
      str_detect(.data[[version_col]], regex("MediumChartjunk|ChartjunkMedium|Medium", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Medium",
      str_detect(.data[[version_col]], regex("LowChartjunk|ChartjunkLow|Low", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Low",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
}

# Order/format factors
# hierarchy is nominal (not ordinal)
dat0 <- dat0 %>% mutate(
  hierarchy = factor(hierarchy),
  # chartjunk is ordinal
  chartjunk = factor(chartjunk,
                     levels = c("Low","Medium","High"),
                     ordered = TRUE)
)

# Longstring exclusion if available
if ("longstring_flag" %in% names(dat0)) {
  dat0 <- dat0 %>% filter(!coalesce(longstring_flag, FALSE))
}

# SurveyWave optional (used only for covariate/control if present)
if ("surveywave" %in% names(dat0)) {
  dat0 <- dat0 %>% mutate(surveywave = factor(surveywave))
}

# Resolution covariates (robust detection)
nm <- names(dat0)

cand_h <- nm[str_detect(nm, regex("(screen|browser|res(olution)?|client).*height", ignore_case = TRUE))]
cand_w <- nm[str_detect(nm, regex("(screen|browser|res(olution)?|client).*width",  ignore_case = TRUE))]

res_h_col <- cand_h[1] %||% NA_character_
res_w_col <- cand_w[1] %||% NA_character_

# Explicit area column, if any
cand_area <- nm[str_detect(nm, regex("res(olution)?_?area|screen_?area|area_px", ignore_case = TRUE))]
res_area_col <- cand_area[1] %||% NA_character_

dat0 <- dat0 %>% mutate(
  res_height = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[res_h_col]])),
  res_width  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[res_w_col]]))
)

# Compute area if we can, else use provided
if (!is.na(res_area_col)) {
  dat0 <- dat0 %>% mutate(res_area = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[res_area_col]])))
} else if (all(c("res_width","res_height") %in% names(dat0))) {
  dat0 <- dat0 %>% mutate(res_area = res_width * res_height)
}

# Keep analysis-ready subset
datA <- dat0 %>%
  filter(!is.na(score), !is.na(hierarchy), !is.na(chartjunk)) %>%
  rename(chartjunk_ord = chartjunk) %>%
  droplevels()

summary(datA$hierarchy); summary(datA$chartjunk_ord)
```

## ANOVA: hierarchy × chartjunk (no covariates)

```{r anova-main, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
m_anova <- lm(score ~ hierarchy * chartjunk_ord, data = datA)
anova(m_anova)

# sjPlot table of coefficients
sjPlot::tab_model(m_anova, show.std = TRUE, show.aic = TRUE, dv.labels = "Score")

# Interaction plot
sjPlot::plot_model(m_anova, type = "int", terms = c("hierarchy", "chartjunk_ord"))
```

### Main-effect plots (predicted means)

```{r main-effects, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=4}
# hierarchy main effect (marginalized over chartjunk)
sjPlot::plot_model(m_anova, type = "pred", terms = "hierarchy")

# chartjunk (ordinal) main effect
sjPlot::plot_model(m_anova, type = "pred", terms = "chartjunk_ord")
```

### Effect sizes (η² / partial η²)

```{r anova-effectsizes}
anova_tbl <- anova(m_anova)
effectsize::eta_squared(anova_tbl, partial = FALSE)
effectsize::eta_squared(m_anova, partial = TRUE)  # partial η²
```

## ANCOVA: adjusting for resolution (height vs. area)

```{r ancova-resolution, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
# Choose available resolution covariates
has_h <- "res_height" %in% names(datA) && any(is.finite(datA$res_height))
has_a <- "res_area"   %in% names(datA) && any(is.finite(datA$res_area))

models <- list()

if (has_h) {
  m_ancova_h <- lm(score ~ hierarchy * chartjunk_ord + res_height + surveywave, data = datA)
  models$Height <- m_ancova_h
}
if (has_a) {
  m_ancova_a <- lm(score ~ hierarchy * chartjunk_ord + res_area + surveywave, data = datA)
  models$Area <- m_ancova_a
}

if (length(models) == 0) stop("No usable resolution covariate found (height or area).")

# sjPlot tables
do.call(sjPlot::tab_model, c(models, list(show.std = TRUE, show.aic = TRUE, dv.labels = "Score")))

# Compare which resolution covariate is more informative
cmp <- tibble::tibble(
  Model = names(models),
  AIC   = purrr::map_dbl(models, AIC),
  BIC   = purrr::map_dbl(models, BIC),
  R2    = purrr::map_dbl(models, ~ broom::glance(.x)$r.squared %||% NA_real_),
  AdjR2 = purrr::map_dbl(models, ~ broom::glance(.x)$adj.r.squared %||% NA_real_)
) %>% arrange(AIC)
cmp
```

### ANCOVA interaction & main-effect plots

```{r ancova-plots, fig.width=7, fig.height=4, results='hide'}
m_ref <- models[[1]]

# Interaction (hierarchy × chartjunk)
sjPlot::plot_model(m_ref, type = "int", terms = c("hierarchy", "chartjunk_ord"))

# Main effects
sjPlot::plot_model(m_ref, type = "pred", terms = "hierarchy")
sjPlot::plot_model(m_ref, type = "pred", terms = "chartjunk_ord")
```

### Trend test for chartjunk (ordinal)

```{r chartjunk-trend}
# Polynomial (linear, quadratic) trends via emmeans
emms <- emmeans::emmeans(m_anova, ~ chartjunk_ord)
emmeans::contrast(emms, method = "poly")
```

### Optional: report-friendly tables

```{r report-tables, results='asis'}
# Type-III ANOVA (if you prefer)
car::Anova(m_anova, type = 3)

# Partial η² for ANCOVA (first model shown)
m_ref <- models[[1]]
effectsize::eta_squared(car::Anova(m_ref, type = 3), partial = TRUE)
```
